HUSKY: Humanoid Skateboarding System via Physics-Aware Whole-Body Control Robotics: Science and Systems (RSS) 2026 Jinrui Han * 1,2 , Dewei Wang * 1,3 , Chenyun Zhang 1 , Xinzhe Liu 1,4 , Ping Luo 2 , Chenjia Bai †1 , Xuelong Li †1 * Equal Contribution † Corresponding Author 1 Institute of Artificial Intelligence (TeleAI), China Telecom 2 The University of Hong Kong 3 University of Science and Technology of China 4 ShanghaiTech University [ ](https://mujocolab.github.io/mjlab/main/index.html) [ ](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03205) [ ](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.03205.pdf) [ ](https://husky-humanoid.github.io/) [ ](https://x.com/jinrui82) ## Overview [ ]() This repository contains the official implementation of our paper: [HUSKY: Humanoid Skateboarding System via Physics-Aware Whole-Body Control](https://husky-humanoid.github.io/). In this work, we propose a learning-based whole-body control framework that empowers humanoid robots to perform dynamic skateboarding. This repository contains: - The mjlab training framework ([`src/mjlab_husky`](src/mjlab_husky)) - Customized RL implementations ([`rsl_rl/`](rsl_rl/)) - Motion data for AMP and trajectory planning ([`dataset/`](dataset/)) - Lightweight MuJoCo evaluation scripts ([`test_scene/`](test_scene/)) - Tested checkpoints ([`ckpts/`](ckpts/)) ## Install This code has been tested on Ubuntu 22.04 with CUDA 13.0. To install this repository, please follow these steps: 1. **Install the [`uv`](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/#installation-methods) package manager** (if you don't have it yet): 2. **Clone the repository**: 3. **Sync dependencies**: ## Training Example ## Play Examples We also provide a lite MuJoCo simulation script for evaluation: The [`test_scene/mjlab_scene.xml`](test_scene/mjlab_scene.xml) file is automatically generated from the mjlab [`scene_cfg`](src/mjlab_husky/asset_zoo/robots/skateboard/g1_skater_constants.py). abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于学习的全身控制框架，使人形机器人能够执行动态滑板动作。该框架结合了物理感知的全身控制策略，通过强化学习在仿真环境中训练，并成功迁移到真实机器人上。我们展示了机器人能够完成平衡、转向、加速等复杂滑板技巧，证明了该方法的有效性和鲁棒性。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出HUSKY，一种物理感知的基于强化学习的全身控制方法，结合动作模仿与轨迹规划实现滑板运动。


# 一、动机

> 人形机器人尚缺乏能实现动态滑板运动的物理感知全身控制框架。


# 二、方法

> 提出HUSKY，一种物理感知的基于强化学习的全身控制方法，结合动作模仿与轨迹规划实现滑板运动。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 在MuJoCo仿真中验证了控制框架，能够使G1人形机器人执行动态滑板动作（摘要未提供具体量化指标）。


# 四、对我的启发

> 摘要信息有限，未提供完整瓶颈分析；该工作为复杂轮式运动的人形控制提供了可扩展框架，可启发滑冰/滑板类动态平衡任务。
